usdRate.note: The US dollar circulates as legal tender; the balboa (PAB) is fixed at par and issued only as coins.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: INEC Panamá, Índice de Precios al Consumidor, as reported by Trading Economics
inflation_cpi.note: Year-on-year CPI inflation 2.8% in September 2026 (2.2% in August), published by INEC on 14 October 2026; the INEC site shows the same 2.8%. 2025 annual average -0.1%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: INEC CPI: -0.1% in 2025, 2.8% in September 2026; US dollar is the currency (Trading Economics)
inflation_projection.note: Panama uses the US dollar and has no central bank, so its inflation tracks US inflation over time; planning uses 2%, close to the long-run average.

policy_rate.note: Panama has no central bank or monetary policy rate; the US dollar is legal tender. The Superintendencia de Bancos publishes interbank rates (3 months 3.83%, week of 17-23 October 2026) for information only.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá, Tarifario de tasas nominales, cuentas de ahorro básicas, septiembre 2026
savings_account_rate.note: Median nominal rate on basic savings accounts across 29 banks in September 2026 (range 0.05%-2.5%); figures are informative and not binding on banks.

fdr_3m_rate.note: The Superintendencia de Bancos tarifario reports term-deposit rates only as a single 'up to 1 year' figure per bank; no separate 3-month rate was found.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá, Tarifario de tasas nominales, depósitos a plazo fijo con vencimiento hasta 1 año, septiembre 2026
fdr_1y_rate.note: Median nominal rate on fixed-term deposits of up to 1 year across 29 banks in September 2026 (range 1.25%-5.25%, mean 3.66%).

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product with a published average rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: No weighted average deposit rate for Panama was found; the World Bank's last FR.INR.DPST value is from 2006. Posted rates are in the Superintendencia de Bancos tarifario (see the savings and 1-year slots).

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found; the Ministry of Economy and Finance issues Letras and Notas del Tesoro to the market.

tbill_91d_rate.note: Treasury bills (Letras del Tesoro) are generally 12-month instruments sold at periodic auctions (MEF, October 2026); no 3-month yield was found, and the MEF yield-curve page did not show figures.

tbond_5y_rate.note: The MEF public debt yield-curve page could not be read (figures load dynamically), and no other source for a 5-year yield was found.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No reachable source for the 10-year government bond yield was found; the MEF yield-curve page did not show figures.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Panama, corporate income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest on bank accounts in Panama and earnings on government securities are exempt income, as the page notes for the dividend rule (page reviewed 4 August 2026).

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Panama, corporate income determination
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No separate savings certificate exists; interest and earnings on securities issued by the government are exempt income.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit insurance scheme was found: the Superintendencia de Bancos consumer and FAQ pages do not mention deposit insurance or a guarantee, but no source confirming that none exists could be read.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá, Tarifario de tasas nominales, tarjetas de crédito, septiembre 2026
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Median nominal annual credit card rate across 24 banks in September 2026 (range 9%-26.5%); a typical rate, not a legal cap.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Few shares trade locally; global equities in US dollars; 1-year deposit 3.75% tax-free (SBP tarifario)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: global shares disappoint and return less than tax-free deposits.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity index in US dollars; tax-free 1-year deposit 3.75% (SBP tarifario)
equity_return_base.note: Panama's exchange lists few shares, so equity is a global index fund in US dollars (the local currency): about 3.25 points over tax-free one-year deposits.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity long-run record in US dollars
equity_return_high.note: High case: global shares repeat their long-run record.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold USD 3,876/oz on 30 Oct 2026, 3% lower in a year (Trading Economics)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold stays flat in dollars.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold USD price trend (Trading Economics); US dollar is the currency
gold_return_base.note: Base case: gold tracks long-run dollar inflation plus a little.

gold_return_high.note: High case: gold resumes its 2020s uptrend.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Savings accounts 1%, 1-year deposits 3.75% (SBP tarifario), interest tax-exempt
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: a mix of savings accounts and short deposits after rates fall.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: 1-year fixed deposit median 3.75%, tax-exempt (SBP tarifario; PwC)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: one-year fixed deposits, with no tax on the interest.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Top 1-year deposit rates 5-5.25% (SBP tarifario); government notes
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: the better-paying deposits or medium-term government notes.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The Superintendencia de Seguros y Reaseguros publishes market statistics, but no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold in Panama, but no regulator or other non-company source with indicative premiums by age was found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No regulator or other non-company source of private health insurance premiums by age was found.

oop_health_share.note: Out-of-pocket spending was 40.5% of current health expenditure in 2023 (latest available; older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.note: Medical costs usually rise faster than general prices; planning uses 3.5%, 1.5 points above projected inflation.

goal_inflation_education.note: School fees usually rise a little faster than general prices; planning uses 3%.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years derived from the 'life expectancy by current age' table for 2026 (UN WPP).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 14.7 in 2025 (World Bank), 23.4 in 2040 and 38.2 in 2065 (UN WPP medium variant).

retirement_age_default.note: The Caja de Seguro Social old-age pension ages (after the 2025 reform, Ley 462) could not be confirmed: the CSS site refused access and the law text could not be reached.

retirement_age_government.note: Public employees are covered by the Caja de Seguro Social; the retirement age could not be confirmed from an official source that could be reached.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: deposit rates fall with US rates.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case: mostly one-year deposits, kept just below the tax-free one-year deposit rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Top 1-year deposit rates 5-5.25% (SBP tarifario); government notes
retirement_return_high.note: High case: better-paying deposits and medium-term government notes.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a mix of deposits and global equity.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half deposits and half global equity in US dollars.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: equities do well and deposit rates stay high.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: The non-contributory '120 a los 65' programme (Ministerio de Desarrollo Social) pays older people without a pension, but its page was behind a verification challenge and the current amount could not be confirmed.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: The eligibility rules of the '120 a los 65' programme could not be read (MIDES page behind a verification challenge).

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code provides a seniority premium (prima de antigüedad) on the end of an indefinite contract, but the Ministry of Labour site refused access, so the days-per-year rule could not be confirmed.

public_pension_scheme.note: The Caja de Seguro Social pension rules after the 2025 reform could not be documented from an official source that could be reached.

fdr_3m.localName: Depósito a plazo fijo a 3 meses
fdr_3m.note: Short fixed deposits are offered; the regulator's rate table groups all terms up to 1 year.

fdr_1y.localName: Depósito a plazo fijo a 1 año

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No retail government savings certificate was found.

tbill_91d.note: Letras del Tesoro are generally 12-month bills sold at periodic auctions (MEF, October 2026); a regular 3-month bill was not found.

tbond_5y.note: Medium-term notes are sold at auction with term and coupon set each time; yields could not be sourced.

tbond_10y.localName: Bonos de la República de Panamá
tbond_10y.note: Long-term dollar bonds trade through securities brokers; yields could not be sourced.

equity_fund.note: Funds are regulated by the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores; global equity funds and ETFs are bought through securities brokers.

insuranceRegulator.name: Superintendencia de Seguros y Reaseguros de Panamá

insuranceComplaints.name: Superintendencia de Seguros y Reaseguros de Panamá, consumer complaints
insuranceComplaints.note: A dedicated complaints page could not be confirmed; complaints go to the Superintendencia.

pensionScheme.name: Caja de Seguro Social (CSS), Invalidez, Vejez y Muerte

oldAgeAllowance.name: Programa Especial de Transferencia Económica a los Adultos Mayores (120 a los 65), MIDES

publicHealthCover.name: Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) and Caja de Seguro Social public health services

statistics.name: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Censo (INEC), Contraloría General
